name: Testudo Helmet Disrupt Camo
description:
Keep your eyes on the prize and your head protected with the Testudo helmet. It features a wide faceplate and a durable outer shell that protrudes above the forehead in a way specifically designed to absorb and efficiently disperse the energy of impacts.

The Disrupt Camo edition utilizes carbon fiber grays and blacks printed in a disruptive pattern to keep your enemies guessing.
